title: Pura Vida: forests, ecotourism and clean energy
goal: Tell how Costa Rica protected its forests and what came before and after, with antes de que and después de que.
grammar: antes de que and después de que (review)

sections.title: Pura Vida: forests, ecotourism and clean energy
body: In this lesson you read about how Costa Rica stopped cutting its forests, about ecotourism, about electricity and about the phrase *pura vida*. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for saying what came before or after someone else's action: *antes de que* and *después de que*.

items: I can say what happened before or after someone else's action, with *antes de que* and *después de que*.
I can tell how Costa Rica protected its forests.
I can say where most of its electricity comes from.
